reason: This is a cross-cutting change to statement-context/range-fallback handling that touches core planner paths (`logical_plan_builder`, `plan_cache`, `point_get_plan`, partition processing) plus executor/session/expression context wiring. Even if framed as a refactor, moving fallback state into a standalone handler can affect plan selection, plan-cache isolation, and statement/session lifecycle semantics, which is central and risky enough for a blocker/high-severity review.
